field_descriptions.access_code: Password, PIN, or access code needed for delivery (e.g. from a locker).
field_descriptions.available_from: When the item is available for pickup from the store, locker, etc.
field_descriptions.available_through: After this date, the item will no longer be available for pickup.
field_descriptions.has_delivery_method: Method used for delivery or shipping.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
